instrumento: a chrome loupe magnifier resting on a printed press sheet
escena: SCENE (press check, print studio in Santiago, morning, NO faces): a hard shaft of window light cuts across the press sheet. Inside the loupe, the halftone rosette is razor sharp and its CYAN dots read as a deep azure blue field — the brand blue lives here, in the ink itself, at real magnification. Beside the loupe on the sheet, an ORANGE grease pencil lies where it was set down, its lacquer catching the light; it is the only warm accent in the frame and occupies a small part of it. Only two fingers steady the loupe at the frame edge, caught at the instant they press it down to focus. 100mm macro at f/4. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the dark walnut worktop in shadow, a hand's width from the lens
